title: Cluster Head- Last Mile
description:
**About The Team**
Being part of Meesho's Fulfilment and Experience (F&E) team as Cluster Head LM,
  
  
will zip you to the cockpit of our ever-burgeoning rocketship, where you get to
  
  
directly shape the experience of the country's next billion e-commerce users.
  
  
We are an eclectic mix of 100+ professionals with diverse skill sets ranging from
  
  
running operations/support, supply chain know-how, analytics and the holy grail,
  
  
first principles problem-solving. At Meesho, we’re trying to do what's never been
  
  
done before - taking e-commerce to the masses. This leaves us with no choice but to
  
  
completely reimagine logistics from the ground up, to cater to our customers' price
  
  
and delivery expectations. That means a host of "zero-to-one" projects (takers,
  
  
anyone?) to build a supply chain to change how folks think about e-commerce
  
  
in India and globally. We are firm believers in fun at work. With monthly F&E happy
  
  
hour sessions, informal team outings, and internal virtual water cooler chat sessions,
  
  
there’s never a dull moment with us
  
  
**About The Role**
As Cluster Head LM, you’ll own the onboarding and training of partners. You’ll also
  
  
drive key operational metrics by regularly visiting their facilities in different cities in
  
  
your area. You’ll take complete ownership of processes allotted to you and work
  
  
with various stakeholders to achieve team goals. You’ll continuously work towards
  
  
identifying gaps and providing recommendations for improving our processes.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the onboarding and training of new partners for Last Mile operations in your cluster
* Identify and onboard new partners onto the network on an ongoing basis
* Track and own the performance of different partners in your cluster
* Visit facilities to conduct audits and solve operational gaps
* Ensure compliance with operational processes
* Own and drive critical operational metrics end to end and achieve performance
* targets
* Continuously work towards identifying gaps and provide recommendations for
* improving our processes

**What You Will Need**

* Graduate or Post Graduate degree in any discipline
* 3-5 years of work experience in the e-commerce logistics domain
* Experience in partner onboarding and training in the Last Mile and sorting operations
* Experience in control tower and field operations will be a plus

**About Us**
Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.
  
  
**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**
****Our Mission****
Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.
  
  
We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.
  
  
Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.
  
  
****Culture and Total Rewards****

title: Customer Success Software Configuration Engineering -Billing
description:
TITLE
  
  
Software Configuration Engineering Senior Analyst
  
  
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Software Configuration Engineering Senior Analyst plays a critical role and is responsible for upgrading client applications to the latest base versions. This involves a thorough understanding of the current application landscape and the new version's features and improvements. Post-upgrade, the engineer will identify, debug, and resolve any issues that arise. This ensures that the upgraded applications function seamlessly and meet client expectations. The engineer will analyze client code to identify deviations and determine what can be upgraded directly and what requires client confirmation.
  
  
The Software Configuration Engineering Senior Analyst will work closely with various departments, including development, quality assurance, and client support teams, to ensure a smooth upgrade process and effective issue resolution
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Meticulously analyze and assess the impact of upgrades based on release notes and code changes for new release features. This involves understanding the nuances of each release and predicting how these changes will affect the existing applications.
* Debugs custom code and base code to provide workarounds or solutions to third-party implementation teams or customers. This requires a deep understanding of the application and the ability to quickly diagnose and resolve issues.
* Leverage Duck Creek upgrade tools to generate differential analysis and produce low-impact upgrade paths for Duck Creek customers.
* Leverage AI-driven tools and processes to identify automation opportunities and reduce manual effort across product upgrade and certification activities.
* Apply strong product implementation knowledge and technical expertise to effectively support product upgrade and certification processes
* Expected to act independently, demonstrating initiative and self-reliance in managing their tasks and responsibilities.
* Identify opportunities to automate processes or develop utilities that assist in faster and more effective upgrades.
* Interacts with customer counterparts to triage issues and present solutions.
* Reviews, Mentors and Shares knowledge with the team members.
* Informs the Technical Lead and Project Manager of any issues and risk that may affect overall upgrade schedules.

* Perform all other duties and activities as required.
* Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values:

+ Mission: To empower insurers to reimagine the future of insurance
+ Vision: To transform insurance technology, helping insurers be smarter, faster, and more efficient, and ultimately provide the best protection for people and businesses
+ Values: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree, or higher educational level, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science strongly preferred
* Minimum 3 years’ related industry experience in system development and implementation
* Demonstrated proficiency in Analysis, Development, and Triage.
* Demonstrated proficiency and implementation experience in Duck Creek Billing Product
* Strong understanding of Duck Creek Billing concepts such as billing forms, billing plans, payment plans, Direct Bill, Agency Bill, EFT/payment processing, and billing transactions
* Hands-on development experience with C#, .NET, SQL Server, XML/XSLT, REST/SOAP APIs, and Duck Creek extensibility/configuration
* Experience with SQL query development, stored procedures, database troubleshooting, and performance optimization
* Demonstrated proficiency in Insurance domain knowledge

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Knowledge of insurance products a plus
* Experience/knowledge of P&C Insurance software applications a plus
* Experience/knowledge of software development life cycle for P&C insurance software a plus
* Experience developing and troubleshooting integrations between Duck Creek Billing and external systems, such as Policy, payment gateways, general ledger, or document-generation systems
* Good to have knowledge in TFS, GitHub and GIT workflow.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
* Experience in Duck Creek Billing upgrades/certifications and assessing customizations, integrations, and compatibility

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements—without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.
  
  
To learn more: https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/
  
  
AI STATEMENT
  
  
To ensure an equitable and consistent process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews based on their own knowledge and experience. The use of AI tools during interviews is not permitted.
  
  
PRIVACY NOTICE
  
  
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Duck Creek Technologies may collect and process your personal data – Refer Privacy Notice
  
  
NOTICE
  
  
Duck Creek Technologies does not accept agency resumes.

title: Creative Strategist & Client Success Manager
description:
About Bforbranding

Bforbranding is the parent organization behind ShortVids, ShortM, and ShortX. We work with international clients across content, performance marketing, and automation. Our focus is on structured execution, strong fundamentals, and long-term scalable growth

ShortVids is a Creative-as-a-Service company helping agencies and growing brands produce high-performing organic content and paid advertising creatives at scale.

Our team delivers short-form videos, long-form content, UGC-style ads, Meta and YouTube ads, VSLs, motion graphics, static ads, carousels and repurposed content.

We are looking for a Creative Strategist & Client Success Manager who can take complete ownership of client strategy, communication, creative quality and delivery operations.

About the role
  

This is not a position where you simply forward messages between clients and editors.

You will understand each client’s business, plan their organic and paid content strategy, convert ideas into actionable creative briefs, manage production, review every important deliverable and ensure clients receive accurate, polished work on time.

Your primary outcome will be:

Every client receives strategically strong, brand-aligned creatives without needing to supervise our production process.

Key responsibilities
  

Creative strategy :

* Understand each client’s business, offer, audience, brand and objectives
* Develop monthly organic content strategies and content pillars
* Plan topics, formats, hooks and content calendars
* Create concepts and angles for Meta and YouTube advertising
* Plan UGC, founder-led, static, carousel, VSL and performance-ad concepts
* Research competitors, trends and winning creative patterns
* Review content and advertising performance to improve future concepts
* Identify creative fatigue and maintain a consistent pipeline of fresh ideas

Client success :

* Manage onboarding, strategy and review calls
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients
* Communicate timelines, progress, blockers and next steps proactively
* Present strategic recommendations clearly and confidently
* Organise client feedback and convert it into actionable revision notes
* Identify dissatisfied or at-risk clients before issues escalate
* Build strong relationships that position ShortVids as a creative partner

Production and operations :

* Convert strategies and client requirements into detailed production briefs
* Provide editors with scripts, references, timestamps, brand assets and clear instructions
* Coordinate editors, designers and other production team members
* Track projects from briefing through editing, revisions and final delivery
* Maintain accurate project boards and client documentation
* Ensure every deadline is communicated and met
* Improve briefing, feedback and delivery processes

Creative quality control :

* Review videos and creatives before they are delivered
* Ensure every client instruction has been followed
* Check hooks, pacing, storytelling, captions, footage, audio and CTAs
* Verify spelling, names, claims, numbers, logos, fonts and brand consistency
* Check aspect ratios, resolution and export quality
* Identify weak creative execution and provide precise improvement notes
* Prevent previously corrected mistakes from recurring

Who we’re looking for
  

* 3+ years of experience in a creative, video production, social media or performance marketing agency
* Experience communicating directly with international clients
* Strong understanding of both organic content and paid advertising creatives
* Ability to develop content plans, creative concepts and editor-ready briefs
* Strong understanding of hooks, storytelling, retention, pacing and CTAs
* Working knowledge of video editing and the ability to recognise quality issues
* Excellent written and spoken English
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously
* Confidence when providing feedback to editors and recommendations to clients
* Familiarity with tools such as Slack, Frame.io, Trello, ClickUp, Notion and Google Drive

Performance marketing knowledge
  

You should understand :

* Creative testing and creative fatigue
* Hooks, angles, offers and awareness levels
* UGC and founder-led advertising
* CTR, hook rate, hold rate and conversion rate
* CPA, CAC and ROAS
* Creative variations and testing grids
* Direct-response storytelling
* Funnel stages and campaign objectives

You do not need to be an advanced media buyer, but you must understand how creative decisions influence advertising performance.

You’ll be a strong fit if you :
  

* Notice details that other people miss
* Think strategically while remaining highly organised
* Take ownership instead of waiting for reminders
* Can manage creative teams without creating unnecessary friction
* Communicate problems early and offer solutions
* Can handle demanding clients calmly and professionally
* Understand the difference between personal preference and a genuine creative problem
* Have extremely high standards for anything delivered to a client

Success in this role looks like

* Clients always know what is happening with their projects
* Organic and paid creative plans are delivered consistently
* Editors receive complete briefs requiring minimal clarification
* Creatives are delivered on time and without preventable errors
* Revision rounds decrease because instructions are clearer
* Client feedback is documented and applied to future work
* Clients receive proactive ideas—not just completed editing tasks
* Routine client and production management does not require founder involvement

Please begin your application with the words “Creative Ownership” so we know you have read the complete job description.

title: Partner Success Manager

About Swiggy:
  
  
Swiggy is India's leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500 cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation.
  
  
Built on the back of robust ML technology and fueled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India.
  
  
From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming a logistics hub of excellence today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
  
  
With Swiggy's New Supply and the recent launches of Swiggy Instamart, Swiggy Genie, and Guiltfree, we are consistently making waves in the market, while continually growing the opportunities we offer our people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
The Partner Success Manager / Senior Account Manager will own the post-sales relationship with restaurant partners,
  
  
ensuring successful adoption, active usage and measurable ROI. The role is central to driving partner satisfaction,
  
  
retention and revenue growth while acting as a trusted growth advisor to restaurant partners.
  
  

* Partner Onboarding & Adoption
* Own end-to-end post-sales onboarding of the product suite for assigned restaurant partners, including Digital Menu,

CRM tools, reservations and QR-based ordering.
  
  

* Coordinate product setup, POS integration, QR deployment and account configuration, including menus, floor

plans, shifts and outlet details.
  
  

* Conduct structured product walkthroughs, demos and staff training to ensure smooth go-live within defined

timelines.
  
  

* Partner Success & Relationship Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for restaurant partners in the city.
* Build strong, long-term relationships with owners, decision-makers and outlet managers.
* Regularly engage partners through check-ins, reviews and on-ground visits.
* Driving ROI & Business Growth
* Help restaurant partners translate product feature usage into measurable business outcomes.
* Drive higher AOV/table value through upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
* Improve repeat visits using CRM and targeted campaigns.
* Enable better table utilization and demand shaping.
* Reduce operational friction through QR-led ordering and billing.
* Track and communicate ROI metrics such as adoption depth, repeat-rate uplift, campaign performance and

menu-led revenue impact.
  
  

* Performance Monitoring & Reviews
* Conduct monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) with partners.
* Analyze partner performance data and recommend actionable improvements.
* Identify early warning signs of churn and proactively resolve issues.
* Expansion & Feature Adoption Support
* Identify opportunities to increase depth of usage across available product features.
* Train restaurant staff on new workflows and maintain adoption through repeat training and SOPs, especially during staff changes.
* Support expansion across multiple outlets by demonstrating value and sharing best practices.
* Work closely with Sales and City teams to enable renewals and portfolio expansion through strong post-sales outcomes.
* Product Support & Issue Resolution
* Act as the first-level support point for product-related queries and issues.
* Coordinate with Product, Tech, Ops and Support teams to resolve bugs, integrations and workflow challenges.
* Ensure minimal downtime and a smooth partner experience.
* Partner Feedback & Continuous Improvement
* Act as the voice of restaurant partners by sharing structured feedback on product usability, gaps and enhancement needs.
* Contribute inputs to improve product features, onboarding journeys and partner-facing processes.

Key Success Metrics (KPIs)
  
  

* Product feature adoption and activation rate
* Partner retention and churn reduction
* Usage frequency across product features
* Partner ROI and satisfaction metrics, including NPS
* Revenue expansion from existing partners

**Qualifications**
Experience & Qualifications
  
  

* 4–7 years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Partner Success or B2B relationship

management.
  
  

* Prior experience in F&B;, hospitality, SaaS, CRM, POS or restaurant technology is highly preferred.
* Experience managing city-level or portfolio-based accounts is a strong plus.

Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Good understanding of business metrics, ROI and growth levers.
* Comfortable working with data, dashboards and performance reports.
* Ability to train and influence non-technical restaurant owners and staff.
* High ownership mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication skills; local language proficiency and English preferred.

**Additional Information**
**Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes**
**We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.**

title: Senior Manager, Client Consulting - AI
description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary:
  
  
The Sr. Client Consulting Manager is responsible for proactively managing operational relationships with key Visa clients, acting as a liaison and escalation point for client issues, and leading internal and external recovery efforts for product and processing service interruptions. This role coordinates internal resources to accomplish Visa and client objectives, drives problem and communication management for critical issues, and builds and enhances positive working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders. The Sr. Client Consulting Manager also leads enablement activities for new and existing products, reports project accomplishments to senior management, and engages with Technology and Product organizations to identify permanent solutions to operational issues. The role is vital in helping Visa deliver against the operational needs of key markets, providing support and partnership that recognizes client-specific requirements, and driving value through effective enablement and customer-centric support.
  
  
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary liaison for clients, providing problem management, proactive identification of processing efficiencies, service change support, and system enhancement support.
* Coordinate internal resources to accomplish Visa and client objectives, accelerating time to revenue.
* Lead and manage operational initiatives, special projects, and client-driven continuous improvement plans.
* Drive problem and communication management for any critical issue affecting a client or visa.
* Educate and train clients on best practices for Visa Commercial and Money Movement Solutions products.
* Participate in cross-functional customer service delivery initiatives across clients and Visa internal teams.
* Engage Technology and Product organizations to regularly review and identify permanent solutions to operational issues.
* Represent customer change requests, system or operational requirements, and negotiate and manage expectations internally and externally.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve the client experience by streamlining operational processes.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a bachelor’s degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD.
* Experience in acting as a liaison and escalation point for clients.
* Experience in managing operational initiatives and special projects.
* Experience in coordinating internal resources to achieve business objectives.
* Experience in problem management and communication for critical client issues.
* Experience in educating and training clients on product best practices.
* Experience in engaging with technology and product teams to resolve operational issues.
* Experience in representing and negotiating customer change requests.
* Experience in identifying and implementing process improvements.
* Experience in participating in cross-functional service delivery initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a bachelor’s degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* Experience with operational experience relating to card, remittance and money movement solutions
* Experience with authorization and clearing, client connectivity, and settlement.
* Experience in relating operational needs of clients to their business drivers.
* Demonstrated record of accomplishment in understanding, anticipating, and delivering client needs.
* Experience in supporting growth initiatives and driving value-added services.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
**About Kapture CX**
Founded in Bengaluru in 2014,
**Kapture CX**
began as an enterprise customer support software company and has evolved into an
**AI-first Agentic Operating System for Enterprises**
.
  
  
Kapture helps enterprises scale AI execution while keeping humans in control. Its
**AgentOS platform**
enables enterprises to deploy, orchestrate, monitor, and optimize AI agents across critical business workflows — including
**customer support, sales, collections, and claims**
.
  
  
Kapture’s AI agents can execute workflows end-to-end across
**voice, chat, email, messaging, and social channels**
, with human intervention built in wherever judgment, empathy, or decision-making is required.
  
  
**What is this role all about?**
As a
**Customer Experience Manager,**
you become the trusted technical advisor for our clients. You ensure customers successfully onboard, integrate, and scale on Kapture’s platform while proactively solving complex technical challenges and driving long-term value.
  
  
**Sounds interesting?**
Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:
  
  

* You will lead client onboarding and integrations, working hands-on with APIs, JSON payloads, and tools like Postman and cURL to ensure seamless adoption.
* You will own technical support and escalations, diagnosing issues using logs, Kafka, Grafana, Sentry, and collaborating closely with engineering and product teams to drive fast resolutions.
* You will build strong, trusted client relationships by acting as a technical advisor and advocate, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
* You will proactively identify optimization opportunities, conduct platform health checks, and recommend technical strategies to help clients maximize ROI.
* You will document issues, resolutions, and RCAs while sharing feedback and insights to influence product improvements and best practices.

This is a
**Mumbai-based role**
. We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.
  
  
**What does success look like in this role?**
You consistently deliver smooth client experiences, resolve issues before they escalate, and help customers fully leverage Kapture’s platform to achieve measurable business impact.
  
  
**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Here Are The Basic Requirements**

* You have strong hands-on experience with API integrations and system troubleshooting.
* You are comfortable working directly with enterprise clients and managing multiple priorities.
* You can collaborate effectively with engineering, product, sales, and support teams.
* You enjoy solving complex technical problems in fast-paced environments.

**What are the most critical skills for this role?**

* You can debug issues by inspecting logs, tracing errors, and identifying root causes quickly.
* You are proficient with modern tech stacks and monitoring tools like Kafka, Grafana, and Sentry (or similar).
* You communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* You take ownership and think proactively about client success and platform optimization.

**You Will Have An Advantage If You**

* You have prior experience working with CRM platforms like Salesforce or HubSpot.
* You are comfortable working with SQL/NoSQL databases and understanding data flows.
* You have exposure to chatbot technologies or AI-driven automation platforms.
* You enjoy creating clear documentation, troubleshooting guides, and RCAs.

**Why should you be interested?**
**Here’s What You Will Gain From This Role**

* An opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, clients, and business impact.
* Hands-on exposure to large-scale CX automation and AI-powered platforms.
* Collaboration with highly skilled product, engineering, and customer success teams.
* Strong growth opportunities in a fast-scaling global SaaS organization, along with competitive compensation and performance-linked rewards.

title: Senior Client Service Manager
description:
**We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.**
At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.
  
  
Job Title: Client Service Manager / Sr. Client Service Manager (Skale 50)
  
  
**PURPOSE:**
TO BE A KEY POINT OF CONTACT FOR CLIENTS ON A SPECIFIC AREA OF THEIR BUSINESS. TO HANDLE ALL DATA REQUESTS AND PROJECT BRIEFS ENSURING TIMELY, ACCURATE DELIVERY OF INFORMATION AND OFFERING GOOD LEVELS OF INSIGHT, WHILST ALSO CONTRIBUTING TO THE GROWTH OF THE CLIENT’S BUSINESS WITHIN KANTAR WORLDPANEL BY IDENTIFYING POTENTIAL REVENUE OPPORTUNITIES.
  
  
**Client Relationship**
ü Be a key point of contact for a specific area of the client’s business, attending on-site days and owning all related client data requests and project briefs
  
  
ü Deliver a highly responsive service to clients, continuing to build good relationships and trust with your contacts
  
  
ü Understand where Worldpanel complements and competes with other information your client buys
  
  
ü Further develop the client relationship by seeking out opportunities to introduce other Worldpanel capabilities and services to your contacts
  
  
**Account Handling**
ü Be responsible for managing your own day-to-day workload on the area of the business you have responsibility for and establishing priorities with the client as needed
  
  
ü Anticipate client demands and proactively find solutions, rather than just answering requests
  
  
ü Support Manager in client meetings/whilst on-site by preparing meeting material and handling follow-up requests
  
  
ü Personally de-brief key contacts on any requests/project briefs that you have completed
  
  
ü Demonstrate commercial awareness by understanding revenue targets, identifying and acting upon potential revenue opportunities
  
  
ü Manage client expectations if demands are unreasonable or you can see a better approach
  
  
ü Demonstrate an inquisitive nature and desire to go the extra mile for your client contacts
  
  
ü Anticipate client needs and be cognizant of the Worldpanel plans for developing the account
  
  
ü When faced with a problem adopt a positive, solution-driven attitude
  
  
ü Train client users on software and data interpretation
  
  
**Service Development**
ü Highlight and escalate client concerns with any Worldpanel deliverables and help identify potential issues as they arise
  
  
ü Offer your opinion and recommendations to your team manager regarding the relevance and effectiveness of regular deliverables and general client servicing in order to ensure the service’s high standard is maintained.
  
  
ü Share best practices and efficient ways of working with other team members
  
  
**Basic Data & Tracking**
ü Assume responsibility for checking and reviewing any regular reports that are sent out to your client contacts to ensure their accuracy and relevance
  
  
ü Production and interpretation of BIG 5 analyses (Cross Tabs, Gain & Loss, Entry - Erosion, LMH, Multiple Usership) with a focus on finding patterns in the data, highlighting key points and making recommendations
  
  
ü Confidently use the more advanced capabilities within PulsePlus such as Customized Grouping etc
  
  
ü Build a network of contacts within Worldpanel Operations who can help you resolve difficulties with the data or systems if they arise
  
  
**Analysis & Insight**
ü Attend on-site days and de-brief key contacts on any requests/smaller project briefs that you have completed
  
  
ü Discuss briefs with clients, challenging appropriately to make sure requests have been properly thought through and offering advice on how best to tackle issues
  
  
ü Be conversant in the methodology and deliverables of all the panels and services run by the division - eg building a good working knowledge of Expert Services capabilities in order to introduce them as relevant to help solve client issues
  
  
ü Recognise patterns, draw logical conclusions, consider implications and make recommendations based on your analysis and knowledge of the client’s business
  
  
ü Always add value to basic ad-hoc client data requests by adding commentary and drawing out key findings
  
  
ü Draw on your understanding of your client’s business, brand plans and category goals in order to ensure your recommendations are relevant
  
  
ü Be responsible for managing client briefs from start to finish ie - designing correct methodology, running the required analysis, adding interpretation and insight based on category knowledge, delivering back to the client
  
  
**Team, People & Self Development**
ü Actively participate in your Academy training programmes to develop the required skills
  
  
ü Seek opportunities to practice and apply what you have learned in training
  
  
ü Take part in your own performance management using the KWP appraisal system
  
  
ü Ensure you maintain an up-to-date PDP with your line manager - monitor your progress and find solutions for your development needs
  
  
ü Engage with your line manager - seeking their feedback, input and contribution to your development - act upon it appropriately asking for advice when relevant
  
  
ü Build relationships internally, specifically with immediate team with the view to willingly offer help and support to others in the team where possible
  
  
ü Understand your personal impact, and build your reputation as a member of the team who has the confidence to work independently when required, but who is also an active, flexible, confident and trusted team member
  
  
ü Show that you are a positive, inquisitive individual who is prepared to go the extra mile and get involved
  
  
ü Seek out opportunities to grow your client and category knowledge by reading trade press, making store visits, meeting the panel respondents having an opinion on your clients’ products and advertising (and their competitor products/advertising) for example
  
  
**What You'll Bring to Numerator**
**PERSON SPECIFICATION**
**A person in this role is likely to have the ability to:**
ü Gather facts and figures, monitor self and others, and achieve goals in a timely and factual manner
  
  
ü Seek ways of perfecting things, raising standards, reducing errors and overcoming omissions
  
  
ü Bring a sense of urgency to situations, demonstrating an active approach, and a willingness to get involved in order to increase the pace, achieve goals and meet objectives
  
  
ü Take decisions as appropriate, and ensure others do likewise
  
  
ü Provide satisfactory solutions in situations involving the new and unexpected
  
  
ü Have a flexible approach in changing situations and be adaptable in difficult circumstances, continuously striving to achieve a result
  
  
ü Work independently when required, while remaining responsive to feedback and direction received from their line manager
  
  
ü Be curious, demonstrate a real desire to learn, seek out training opportunities and actively participate in meetings (both internal and external as appropriate)
  
  
ü Show dedication to both the client and the client service team, demonstrating a professional work ethic and willingness to go the extra mile when required
  
  
**A person aspiring towards promotion to Account Manager should be demonstrating:**
ü A good understanding of client’s overall goals and objectives, as well as the role that different departments and individuals are playing in achieving these
  
  
ü An increasing network of contacts within the client organisation, not limited to the insight department
  
  
ü An increasing network of internal contacts in “expert” roles within the Kantar Worldpanel India
  
  
ü An awareness of contractual obligations and ability to spot potential conflicts or issues arising
  
  
ü Ability to convert revenue opportunities arising from client issues
  
  
ü Evidence of introducing new concepts or new ways of working with your client
  
  
ü Ability to independently deliver actionable insights focused on things your client can influence
  
  
ü Give junior members coaching and feedback, acting as a role model and mentoring where appropriate
  
  
ü A strong track record of attending and actively participating in training
  
  
ü Ownership of your self development in completing and managing your own PDP, highlighting areas where further development is required

title: Customer Service Manager
description:
**Job Title:**
Customer Service Manager

**Department:**
Customer Service / Operations

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Must-Haves**

·        6–8 years of experience in customer service / client servicing, with significant experience in 3PL, logistics, warehousing or supply chain operations.

·        Strong experience handling large B2B / key customer accounts and senior customer stakeholders.

·        Hands-on understanding of warehouse, transportation, order processing, inventory and distribution operations.

·        Proven experience managing customer escalations, SLAs, service reviews and operational issues.

·        Experience leading and managing a customer service team.

·        Strong understanding of logistics documentation, billing coordination and ERP/WMS/TMS systems.

·        Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

·        Strong analytical ability with experience in MIS, KPI tracking and service performance reporting.

·        Ability to work closely with Operations, Warehouse, Transport, Finance and Commercial teams.

·        Strong ownership of customer satisfaction, service quality and issue resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.     Customer Relationship Management

·        Own relationships with key customers and act as the primary escalation point for service-related matters.

·        Understand customer requirements, SLAs, operational expectations and commercial commitments.

·        Conduct regular customer reviews and track service performance against agreed KPIs.

·        Build strong, long-term relationships with customers and identify opportunities to improve service delivery.

·        Handle escalations and ensure timely resolution in coordination with internal teams.

2.     Order & Logistics Coordination

·        Oversee end-to-end coordination between customers, warehouse, transport and operations teams.

·        Ensure timely order processing, dispatches, deliveries and shipment updates.

·        Monitor operational issues, delays and exceptions and ensure proactive communication with customers.

·        Ensure customer instructions and service requirements are accurately communicated to the relevant teams.

·        Maintain visibility on order, inventory, dispatch and delivery status.

3.     Customer Service Operations

·        Lead the customer service team and establish clear processes for handling customer queries, requests and escalations.

·        Monitor response and resolution timelines and ensure adherence to defined SLAs.

·        Review recurring customer issues and drive corrective and preventive actions.

·        Standardise customer communication, documentation and reporting processes.

·        Ensure accurate maintenance of customer records and service documentation.

4.     MIS & Performance Management

·        Prepare and review daily, weekly and monthly customer service and operational reports.

·        Track KPIs including SLA adherence, order processing, on-time delivery, response time, resolution time, complaints and customer satisfaction.

·        Analyse service performance and identify gaps requiring operational intervention.

·        Present customer performance and key issues to management through regular reviews.

5.     Billing & Commercial Coordination

·        Coordinate with Finance and Operations to ensure accurate and timely customer billing.

·        Verify billing inputs against contracts, work orders, service records and operational data.

·        Support resolution of billing discrepancies and customer queries related to invoices.

·        Track outstanding customer issues impacting billing and collections.

·        Coordinate on customer quotations, rate revisions and service agreements where required.

6.     Documentation & Compliance

·        Ensure accuracy and completeness of shipment and customer documentation, including PODs, invoices, e-way bills and related logistics records.

·        Ensure customer and operational data is accurately maintained in ERP/WMS/TMS systems.

·        Maintain proper records for customer reviews, audits and internal reporting.

·        Ensure adherence to company processes and customer-specific documentation requirements.

7.     Team Management

·        Lead, mentor and manage the customer service team across assigned accounts.

·        Allocate responsibilities and monitor individual and team performance.

·        Train the team on customer processes, systems, communication and escalation handling.

·        Build a proactive customer service culture focused on responsiveness and resolution.

8.     Cross-Functional Coordination

·        Work closely with Warehouse, Transport, Operations, Finance, Sales and Commercial teams to resolve customer requirements.

·        Coordinate internally on capacity, dispatches, inventory, transportation and billing issues.

·        Ensure customer commitments are understood and delivered across functions.

·        Drive cross-functional resolution of recurring service issues.

title: Customer Manager
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You and this Role:**
As a
**Customer Manager – Consumer & Electronics and Mobility & Transportation**
to be located at Navi Mumbai/Bangalore and Pune, you will be responsible for driving profitable growth across strategic accounts and key market segments. You will work closely with OEMs, Tier suppliers, Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) providers and distribution partners to expand Dow's silicone solutions portfolio within Automotive, Electronics, Consumer Applications, Release Coatings, Elastomers, Railways, and other high-growth industries.
  
  
This role offers an exciting opportunity to influence market development, build strong customer partnerships, and contribute to Dow's growth strategy in India.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic customer accounts while identifying new business opportunities.
* Develop strong relationships with OEMs, Tier customers, EMS partners, distributors, and key decision-makers.
* Create and execute territory and account growth plans aligned with business objectives.
* Identify and convert opportunities within target segments including Automotive, Electronics, Consumer Solutions, Elastomers, Railways, and Emerging Technologies.
* Lead opportunity pipeline management, pricing initiatives, contract negotiations, and commercial discussions.
* Collaborate closely with Technical Service & Development (TS&D), Marketing, Product Management, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.
* Conduct regular customer visits, business reviews, and market assessments to identify growth opportunities and competitive insights.
* Drive customer engagement around innovation, sustainability, localization, and new product adoption.

**Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in business administration, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Technology, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Sales, Account Management, Business Development, Technical Sales, Application Development, or Customer-Facing Commercial Roles.
* Proven track record of managing strategic customer relationships and delivering sustainable business growth.
* Strong understanding of commercial sales processes, account planning, opportunity management, and value-based selling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India to support customers and business growth initiatives.

**Preferred Experience:**
Experience in one or more of the following industries & product technology is highly desirable:
  
  

* Silicone and Specialty Chemicals
* Thermal Interface Materials
* Release coatings
* Silicone or other Elastomers.
* Electronics Materials
* EV and Mobility Solutions
* Consumer Solutions

**Your Skills:**

* Customer-focused mindset with strong problem-solving abilities
* Excellent communication and relationship-building capabilities
* Strong commercial acumen with a growth-oriented approach
* Technical aptitude and ability to learn new technologies, applications, and market trends
* Proactive approach to identifying and developing business opportunities
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
* Ability to influence stakeholders and develop long-term customer partnerships
* High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills when collaborating with customers and cross-functional teams

**Additional Notes:**

* Travel within India is required based on business needs.
* Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).

+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
* On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:

+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)

Join our team, we can make a difference together.
  
  
**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science-based products and solutions in high-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
  
  
A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
  
  
As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com.

title: Account Manager
description:
**Job Title:**

Client Success Coach / Account Manager

**Company:**

Mudita

**Location:**

Bangur Nagar, Goregaon West, Mumbai

**Work Mode:**

Full-Time, Work From Office

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

**Experience Required:**

2–4 Years

**Preferred Background:**

EdTech, online coaching, client success, account management, community management, customer success, sales support, or learning program management

**Joining:**

Immediate joiners preferred

**About Mudita**

Mudita is a fast-growing education and transformation company offering outcome-driven learning programs across business, investing, AI, leadership, e-commerce, consulting, trading, and digital growth.

Our current programs include:

* **Algo Intelligence Elite**

  — AI Trading
* **Digital Wealth Domination**

  — Digital Finance
* **Decode Your Wealth**

  — Investing
* **Automate Your Business Using AI**

  — Business & AI
* **Leadership Mastery Action Plan**

  — Leadership
* **Build Your E-commerce Business**

  — E-commerce
* **Build a High-Income Consulting Business**

  — Consulting

We work with entrepreneurs, business owners, professionals, investors, coaches, consultants, creators, and learners who join our programs to build skills, implement systems, and achieve measurable personal or business growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Client Success Coach / Account Manager**

who will be responsible for ensuring that clients enrolled in Mudita’s programs receive the right guidance, support, accountability, and motivation throughout their learning journey.

This role is not just customer support. It is a mix of
**client success, account management, program engagement, implementation support, relationship building, upsell opportunity identification, and client success storytelling**

.

The ideal candidate should be able to build strong relationships with clients, understand their goals, track their progress, help them stay engaged, resolve concerns, coordinate with internal teams, and ensure that clients get maximum value from the programs they have purchased.

The role also involves helping Mudita identify
**client wins, testimonials, case studies, success stories, referrals, and higher upsell opportunities**

from existing clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Conduct onboarding calls with clients after they purchase a Mudita program and clearly explain the program structure, roadmap, timelines, support process, sessions, assignments, recordings, and expected outcomes.
2. Understand each client’s goals, background, challenges, expectations, and reason for joining the program.
3. Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients throughout their program journey.
4. Regularly track client progress, attendance, participation, assignment completion, implementation status, and engagement levels.
5. Follow up with clients to ensure they attend sessions, complete action steps, stay accountable, and continue progressing in the program.
6. Help clients understand the course roadmap, key milestones, learning objectives, implementation steps, and available support systems.
7. Resolve client queries, concerns, doubts, access issues, communication gaps, and support requests in a timely and professional manner.
8. Coordinate with coaches, trainers, speakers, operations, sales, support, and internal teams to ensure smooth client experience.
9. Identify clients who are disengaged, inactive, confused, unhappy, or at risk of dropping off, and take proactive steps to re-engage them.
10. Maintain updated client records, call notes, progress updates, follow-up status, concerns, escalations, feedback, and success indicators in CRM, sheets, or trackers.
11. Build strong client relationships and create a positive, supportive, and trust-based experience for every client.
12. Identify client wins, improvements, progress stories, business results, implementation outcomes, and transformation moments.
13. Collect testimonials, feedback, screenshots, case study inputs, video testimonial opportunities, and client success stories.
14. Help the company create strong
    **client success assets**

    , such as testimonials, case studies, success stories, community highlights, proof posts, and brand-building content.
15. Identify clients who may be suitable for higher-level programs, premium offers, advanced mentorships, renewals, referrals, or upsells.
16. Support ethical and consultative upselling by understanding the client’s needs and recommending suitable next-level programs only where relevant.
17. Coordinate with the sales team or management for upsell opportunities, renewal possibilities, referral leads, and high-potential client accounts.
18. Share regular updates with management regarding client health, engagement, satisfaction, progress, complaints, escalations, testimonials, and upsell opportunities.
19. Help improve client satisfaction, retention, referrals, success ratios, repeat purchases, and overall program outcomes.
20. Support client communities, WhatsApp groups, live sessions, webinars, workshops, bootcamps, and internal communication wherever required.
21. Suggest improvements in client experience, onboarding flow, follow-up process, communication, program delivery, and support systems.

title: Student Support Manager - Edtech Operations
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Student Query and Grievance Management**

* Ensure timely, accurate, and complete resolution of student issues within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Monitor ticket ageing, pending cases, repeat queries, escalations, and unresolved grievances.
* Coordinate with internal teams, institute representatives, faculty, and other stakeholders to resolve issues.

**B. Student Engagement and Retention**

* Proactively engage with students to understand their academic, administrative, and programme-related challenges.

**C. Learner Experience and Satisfaction**

* Monitor recurring student concerns and identify root causes affecting the learner experience.

* Coordinate responses to student feedback and online grievances in accordance with approved communication guidelines.

* Identify emerging reputational risks and escalate sensitive issues promptly.

**F. Process Management and Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures for student query management, outreach, escalation, and closure.
* Maintain accurate student interaction records, ticket histories, follow-up actions, and resolution documentation.
* Analyse recurring issues and recommend preventive measures to reduce repeat queries and operational inefficiencies.
* Work with cross-functional teams to improve turnaround time, communication quality, and overall student experience.

* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) covering query resolution, SLA adherence, student satisfaction, retention, renewals, and outreach effectiveness.
* Prepare periodic dashboards and reports highlighting performance, risks, trends, and corrective actions.

* Coach team members on communication, problem-solving, ownership, and service quality.
* Ensure accountability for assigned activities, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.

title: CRM Manager
description:
**Job description:**

**Job Description: CRM Manager**

**Mid-Senior Level 5–6 Years of Experience**

**Department: Customer Relationship Management**

**Preferred Industries: Wellness, Nutrition, FMCG, Lifestyle, Beauty and D2C**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on CRM Team Lead to manage the entire customer relationship and support function, including CRM executives, chat support executives and sales executives. The ideal candidate should have 5–6 years of experience in customer relationship management, team handling and sales operations, preferably in a D2C or consumer-focused business.

This role will be responsible for managing day-to-day team operations, ensuring high-quality customer interactions across calls and chats, monitoring ticket resolution and turnaround times, and supporting the team in handling escalations, delivery issues and other customer concerns. The candidate should have a strong understanding of CRM tools, reporting, customer service metrics and team performance management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Team Management & Leadership

Lead and manage a team of CRM executives, chat support executives and sales executives, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations.

Allocate responsibilities, monitor individual and team performance, and ensure achievement of defined targets and KPIs.

Conduct regular team meetings, provide coaching and feedback, and support team members in resolving operational challenges.

Ensure adequate team coverage and timely handling of customer interactions across all communication channels.

2. Quality Assurance & Customer Experience

Own the quality of all customer interactions across outbound and inbound calls, chats, emails and social media channels.

Monitor call recordings and chat conversations to ensure adherence to communication standards, brand tone and customer service protocols.

Conduct regular quality audits, identify gaps and implement corrective actions through training and coaching.

Ensure consistent, professional and timely responses to customer queries, complaints and escalations.

3. Customer Support & Issue Resolution

Oversee the daily handling of customer queries, complaints, delivery-related issues, order concerns, refunds and other operational challenges.

Support the team in resolving complex customer issues and escalations, coordinating with relevant internal departments wherever required.

Ensure that all incoming messages across customer communication channels are acknowledged and addressed within the defined turnaround time.

Monitor open and pending tickets, follow up on unresolved cases and ensure timely closure with appropriate resolution.

Establish and maintain clear escalation processes to ensure customer issues are addressed efficiently.

4. CRM Operations & Ticket Management

Manage the daily CRM operations, ensuring accurate tracking and timely resolution of customer tickets across all channels.

Monitor open, closed, pending and escalated tickets, identify backlogs and ensure adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs).

Maintain proper documentation of customer interactions, complaints, resolutions and follow-up activities.

Ensure the team follows standard operating procedures (SOPs) for ticket management, customer communication and issue resolution.

Have a strong working knowledge of CRM tools, ticketing systems and customer support platforms.

5. Sales Operations & Performance Monitoring

Monitor the performance of the sales executives, ensuring consistent follow-ups, customer engagement and achievement of assigned sales targets.

Support the team in driving upselling, cross-selling and repeat purchases through effective customer communication.

Track key sales and service metrics, identify performance gaps and work with team members to improve productivity and conversions.

Ensure coordination between the sales and customer support teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

6. Reporting & Data Analysis

Prepare and maintain daily, weekly and monthly reports covering call volumes, chat volumes, ticket status, resolution rates, customer complaints and team productivity.

Track key metrics such as first response time, average resolution time, ticket backlog, customer satisfaction and quality scores.

Analyse customer interaction data to identify recurring issues, operational bottlenecks and opportunities for process improvement.

Share regular performance updates, operational insights and escalation reports with the CRM Head.

7. Social Media & Omnichannel Support

Oversee customer communication across social media platforms, email, chat, calls and other relevant channels.

Ensure all incoming customer messages, comments and queries are monitored and responded to within the defined turnaround time.

Maintain basic social media customer service hygiene, including timely responses, appropriate communication and escalation of sensitive issues.

Ensure consistent customer service standards and brand communication across all channels.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

5–6 years of experience in CRM, customer service, customer experience or sales operations, preferably in a D2C or B2C business.

Prior experience managing a team of CRM executives, chat support executives and sales executives.

Experience in wellness, nutrition, FMCG, lifestyle, beauty or other consumer-facing industries will be preferred.

Strong understanding of CRM platforms, ticketing systems and omnichannel customer support operations.

Hands-on experience with quality monitoring, call audits, chat audits and team performance management.

Good understanding of customer service metrics, ticket tracking, SLA management and turnaround times.

Basic analytical skills and the ability to prepare and interpret operational reports.

Strong communication, problem-solving, escalation management and people management skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

Performance Area

Key Metrics

Team productivity

Calls and chats handled, individual productivity and target achievement

Quality assurance

Call quality scores, chat quality scores and SOP adherence

Ticket management

Open tickets, closed tickets, backlog and resolution rate

Service efficiency

First response time, average resolution time and SLA adherence

Customer experience

Customer satisfaction, complaints and escalation rate

Sales performance

Revenue, conversions, upselling and cross-selling

Team management

Coaching, training, performance reviews and team productivity

title: Manager - Operations
description:
**At Ayvens, progress starts with you.**
Our ambitions to shape the future of sustainable mobility are powered by our talent. Join us, and get better with every move.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Process Management
* Manage the operational lifecycle of all End of Lease activities, including:
* End of Lease notifications and customer communications
* Lease extension processing
* Vehicle buyback processing
* Vehicle surrender management
* Monitor process milestones and ensure adherence to defined turnaround times (TATs).
* Establish process governance and ensure compliance with operational guidelines.
* Performance Monitoring & Pendency Management
* Maintain complete visibility of all open transactions and process stages.
* Conduct daily reviews of pending cases across all workflows.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions to minimize delays.
* Ensure timely closure of cases and adherence to service level commitments.
* Develop and maintain operational dashboards and management reports.
* Monitor process aging and proactively manage exceptions.
* Escalation Management
* Act as the primary operational escalation point for customer and stakeholder issues.
* Ensure escalations are investigated and resolved within defined timelines.
* Conduct root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement preventive actions.
* Minimize customer complaints through proactive case management.
* Team Leadership & Resource Management
* Manage a team of dedicated process executives responsible for:
* Lease extension operations
* Buyback operations
* Vehicle surrender operations
* Back-office administration and tracking
* Set clear performance objectives for team members.
* Conduct daily operational reviews and weekly performance discussions.
* Monitor individual productivity, quality, accuracy, and backlog management.
* Provide coaching, guidance, and development support to team members.
* Ensure adequate staffing and workload balancing across functions.
* Outsourced Partner Governance
* Manage the performance of outsourced agencies handling customer interaction and fulfillment activities.
* Conduct regular operational reviews with vendor partners along with respective process owner.
* Monitor key performance indicators including:
* Customer response times
* Case closure rates
* TAT adherence
* Service quality
* Customer satisfaction
* Ensure vendor compliance with agreed service standards and contractual obligations.
* Drive accountability and corrective actions for service gaps.
* Process Improvement & Customer Experience Enhancement
* Continuously evaluate operational processes to identify improvement opportunities.
* Drive initiatives to:
* Reduce turnaround times
* Improve customer experience
* Enhance process quality and accuracy
* Increase operational efficiency
* Reduce manual effort and rework
* Implement process automation and digitization opportunities where applicable.
* Measure and track benefits from improvement initiatives.
* Reporting & Governance
* Prepare and present regular operational performance reports.
* Track and report key metrics including:
* Open pendencies
* Aging analysis
* SLA/TAT compliance
* Team productivity
* Vendor performance
* Lead periodic business reviews with internal stakeholders and management.
* Education:

Post Graduate or equivalent degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline.
  
  
Relevant certifications in Process Excellence, Lean, Six Sigma, or Project Management would be an advantage.
  
  

* Experience:

7-10 years of experience in Operations Management, Process Management, Fleet Operations, Automotive Finance, Leasing, Customer Operations, or a related field.
  
  
Experience managing outsourced service providers and operational teams.
  
  
Proven track record of driving process improvements and operational excellence.
  
  
Experience managing customer-facing operational processes with defined SLA/TAT commitments.
  
  

* Skills:

Team Leadership
  
  
Escalation Management
  
  
Vendor Management
  
  
Data Analysis & Reporting
  
  
Customer Experience Management
  
  
Communication & Influencing Skills
  
  
**Why Ayvens?**

At Ayvens, we believe that our success is driven by our commitment to customer satisfaction. Our team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions and technology-enabled services that help our customers focus on their everyday business. We’re committed to sustainable mobility and have made it a core part of our strategy. In everything we do, we’re guided by the principles of authenticity, curiosity, commitment and collaboration. We aim to foster an organisation that's diverse in people and ideas, where everyone can thrive and be themselves, no matter who they are.
  
  
Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to enable the transformation towards large scale adoption of sustainable mobility and provide our customers with the solutions they need to succeed. Follow our page for the latest updates, news, and insights.

* Self-motivated, energetic, and enthusiastic.

title: Vice President, Client Services
description:
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
