For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

**About Mindshare : A Leading WPP Media Brand,**
Mindshare delivers Good Growth for its clients. As “Growth Architects," we drive growth that benefits all stakeholders — better for people, planet, and business — by using media with intention. This approach creates more meaningful connections with consumers, increases consumer trust in the brand, and delivers better outcomes for all stakeholders.
  
  
****Role Summary And Impact****
**Reporting of the Role**
This role reports to:
**Head — Strategy & Intelligence**
****3 Best Things About The Job****

* Category depth with business breadth - You own one category completely - its media landscape, its competitive dynamics, its consumer and cultural context. But you never lose sight of the business. Everything connects back to growth.
* Senior work from day one - This is a client-facing strategic leadership role. You will be in senior conversations, leading strategic recommendations and influencing how some of India's most iconic brands invest in media.
* A strategy practice - You will be joining a team that is reimagining what media strategy looks like - integrating AI, data intelligence and cultural thinking into a practice that goes well beyond traditional media planning.

**In This Role, Your Goals Will Be**
**In 3 months:**
Develop deep working knowledge of your assigned category - brands, competitive landscape, consumer context and media history. Build relationships with key internal and client stakeholders. Begin owning deliverables and contributing meaningfully to strategic discussions.
  
  
**In 6 months:**
Independently lead strategic presentations and recommendations for your category. Become the internal authority on category intelligence. Be proactively bringing insights and opportunities to client teams rather than only responding to briefs.
  
  
**In 12 months:**
Own the strategic agenda for your category. Lead major client reviews independently. Have measurably elevated the quality and ambition of strategic thinking for the portfolio. Be seen by clients as an indispensable strategic partner.
  
  
****Skills And Experience****
**Key Responsibilities**
**Category Strategy & Intelligence**
Lead the strategic intelligence agenda for your assigned category - synthesising competitive media activity, consumer behaviour, cultural trends and business dynamics into clear, actionable strategic narratives for client and internal teams.
  
  
**Client Partnership & Senior Stakeholder Engagement**
Build deep, trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders across brand and media. Drive strategic discussions that connect media investment to brand equity and business outcomes - going beyond campaign execution to category growth thinking.
  
  
**Media Strategy Leadership**
Develop and own the media strategy for your category portfolio - grounded in planning rigour, informed by data and connected to the broader business agenda. Ensure strategy translates consistently from brief to plan to outcome.
  
  
**Competitive & Consumer Intelligence**
Maintain a current and nuanced understanding of the competitive media landscape, consumer media behaviour and emerging cultural trends. Translate these into timely, actionable recommendations that give the brand a strategic edge.
  
  
**Data & Insights**
Build bespoke strategic analyses, deep-dive studies and intelligence frameworks using media data, consumer research tools and secondary sources. Turn complex data into clear points of view.
  
  
**Thought Leadership & Collaboration**
Partner with Central planning, data and activation teams to ensure strategic intent is reflected at every stage of the media investment cycle. Contribute to agency thought leadership and category best practice.
  
  
****What Your Day Job Looks Like****

* Monitoring competitive activity, consumer signals and cultural trends to identify strategic opportunities and risks for your category brands.
* Building and presenting strategic analyses and recommendations for client brand and planning reviews - connecting media thinking to business outcomes.
* Working with planning and data teams to ensure category strategy is reflected accurately in media plans and measurement frameworks.
* Scanning secondary research, social listening tools and consumer survey platforms to build and update category intelligence.
* Adding strategic nuances to CCBT, MOC and AOP discussions - developing the category point of view that shapes investment decisions.
* Collaborating with Central strategy and intelligence teams to build category-specific frameworks, tools and best practices.

****What You Will Need****
**Must Have**

* 10–14 years of experience in media strategy, with a strong foundation of must-have 3–6 years in core media planning at a leading media agency. A solid grounding in planning mechanics - channel strategy, audience and reach thinking, platform dynamics, ROI frameworks - is essential for this role.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver senior-level strategic recommendations - to category heads, marketing directors or equivalent - with confidence and clarity.
* Strong experience working on large FMCG or consumer brand accounts, with an understanding of how brand strategy, consumer insights and media investment connect to business outcomes.
* Excellent analytical capability - ability to work across multiple data sources (media, consumer, competitive, business) and synthesise a clear and actionable point of view.
* Outstanding communication skills - able to simplify complexity, build compelling narratives and present to senior internal and external audiences.
* A proactive, independent working style - someone who brings the agenda rather than waiting for the brief.

**Good to Have**

* Domain expertise in one of the following categories: Beauty & Wellbeing, Home Care, Personal Care or Foods & Nutrition.
* Experience on the brand or strategy side at an FMCG or digital media/tech company.
* Familiarity with AI-powered intelligence tools, social listening platforms and emerging media research methodologies.
* Experience contributing to brand planning, AOP or marketing strategy discussions beyond the media brief.
* Working knowledge of 1PD strategy, audience intelligence frameworks and data-driven planning approaches.

****Minimum Qualifications****

* Postgraduate degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience with a demonstrated foundation in media planning and a track record of strategic leadership.
* Experience managing senior client relationships independently.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: General Manager – Cross-Border Healthcare
description:
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
5+ Years of Experience

**Locations:**
Mumbai, Delhi, Dubai, Geneva, Lagos, Abuja, Nairobi

**Work Mode:**
Remote / Hybrid

Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on General Manager to lead business development, strategic partnerships, and operational coordination for a growing cross-border healthcare business.

The role focuses on connecting patients, referring doctors, hospitals, insurers, and healthcare partners to facilitate access to quality and affordable international medical treatment. The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO and cross-functional teams to expand referral networks, develop hospital partnerships, improve patient coordination, and drive the adoption of a technology-enabled healthcare platform.

Key Responsibilities1. Healthcare Business Development & Partnerships

* Develop and manage relationships with doctors, hospitals, clinics, insurers, corporates, healthcare facilitators, and other referral partners.
* Drive patient referrals and build strategic partnerships across priority markets, particularly in Africa.
* Support partnership negotiations, agreements, onboarding, and ongoing engagement.
* Collaborate with digital marketing teams to support patient acquisition and business growth.

2. International Patient Management & Operations

* Oversee international patient journeys, from initial enquiries and treatment planning to travel, treatment, and post-treatment follow-up.
* Coordinate medical quotations, patient approvals, visa documentation, travel arrangements, accommodation, hospital coordination, insurance approvals, billing, and payments.
* Establish efficient workflows, service standards, and escalation mechanisms.
* Step in directly to resolve complex patient cases and operational challenges when required.

3. Hospital Network Development

* Expand and manage partnerships with hospitals across India, Türkiye, the UAE, Thailand, and other approved destinations.
* Coordinate hospital onboarding, commercial agreements, treatment quotations, and information collection.
* Work with hospitals, patients, and referring doctors to obtain treatment plans and necessary clarifications.
* Ensure clear documentation of patient cases, payment processes, and commercial arrangements.

4. Digital Healthcare Platform Adoption

* Work with product and technology teams to improve a digital platform supporting patients, hospitals, doctors, insurers, and healthcare partners.
* Provide operational feedback, participate in platform testing, and follow up on agreed development priorities.
* Onboard pilot partners and encourage active platform usage to increase patient referrals.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through technology.

5. Business Growth & Strategy

* Research new markets, healthcare services, and partnership opportunities.
* Support initiatives such as surgical camps, telemedicine services, post-treatment care, and insurance-focused healthcare solutions.
* Evaluate pilot projects and recommend opportunities for expansion.
* Support the implementation of business growth initiatives across international markets.

6. Team Management & Reporting

* Coordinate internal teams and external partners across multiple countries.
* Track patient cases, referral partnerships, hospital onboarding, and business development activities.
* Report performance, operational challenges, and key risks to the CEO.
* Ensure timely follow-ups, accountability, and a consistent patient experience.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* At least 4 years of relevant experience in healthcare operations, healthcare business development, patient services, or related fields.
* Strong experience in business development, strategic partnerships, stakeholder management, and team coordination.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage strategic responsibilities while contributing directly to operational activities.
* Comfortable working in a growing business environment with evolving processes.
* Relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in medical tourism, international patient management, medical travel, or cross-border healthcare.
* Experience working with hospitals, doctors, healthcare providers, insurers, or medical facilitators.
* Medical qualifications such as MBBS, BDS, or MDS will be preferred.
* Exposure to digital health platforms, telemedicine, or healthcare technology is an advantage.
* Experience working with international markets, particularly Africa, is desirable.

Key Performance Indicators

* Growth in active healthcare referral partners and qualified patient referrals.
* Number of successfully coordinated international patient cases and patient satisfaction.
* Expansion and performance of the destination-hospital network.
* Adoption of the digital platform by partners and pilot customers.
* Timely patient coordination, operational efficiency, and business growth.

What We Offer

* An opportunity to contribute to the growth of an international healthcare business.
* Exposure to healthcare markets and partners across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East.
* A collaborative work environment with direct access to senior leadership.
* An opportunity to help build technology-enabled solutions that improve international patient access to healthcare.
* Competitive remuneration, with potential performance-linked incentives and stock options.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV along with a brief summary of their relevant experience in healthcare business development, operations, or international patient management.

careers@duretechnologies.com

Application – General Manager, Cross-Border Healthcare

title: Manager Bakery Applications & Technical Services
description:
At Corbion, we exist to champion preservation in all its forms, preserving food and food production, health, and our planet.

**The role**

As Manager Bakery Applications & Technical Services, you will connect customer needs with practical ingredient solutions that support product innovation and commercial growth across India. Your primary focus will be bakery applications, complemented by opportunities in confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry and seafood.

This is a senior, customer-facing technical role rather than a traditional laboratory-based R&D position. You will engage directly with customers and their R&D teams, explore their current and future technical challenges, and translate these insights into viable solutions. Working closely with Corbion’s product management, commercial, regional and global application teams, you will develop, test and implement solutions using Corbion’s portfolio of preservation systems, vinegar-based solutions, cultured ingredients, organic acids, emulsifiers, fermentation-derived ingredients and functional blends.

A unique part of the position is the opportunity to help establish Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai. You will contribute your expertise and recommendations during its development and subsequently lead its activities as a regional innovation hub. The laboratory will support bakery, confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments applications and enable customer solutions to be tested and optimized before implementation at customer locations.

The position is based fully on-site in Navi Mumbai and involves approximately 30% to 40% travel, primarily within India and, where required, selected South Asian markets. Customer implementation and plant trials may require visits of several consecutive days.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build trusted technical partnerships with customers, distributors and strategic accounts by understanding their product, process, quality and manufacturing challenges.
* Work directly with customer R&D teams to identify current and future application needs and translate these into commercially viable ingredient solutions.
* Develop and optimize applications using Corbion’s portfolio of preservation systems, vinegar-based solutions, cultured ingredients, organic acids, emulsifiers, fermentation-derived ingredients and functional blends.
* Lead formulation and application work across bakery, confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry and seafood, with bakery as the primary area of focus.
* Develop solutions addressing shelf-life extension, food safety, clean-label reformulation, texture enhancement, yield improvement, flavour optimization and cost-in-use reduction.
* Take customer development projects from initial needs assessment and laboratory trials through validation, implementation and commercialization.
* Design and conduct application trials, including ingredient selection, dosage optimization and process improvement, to identify solutions customers can efficiently validate and implement.
* Lead customer plant trials, industrial validation and implementation across multiple manufacturing locations where required.
* Troubleshoot formulation, preservation, processing and implementation challenges, and conduct product benchmarking and competitive evaluations.
* Work with regional and global product management and application teams to adapt existing knowledge and solutions to Indian market requirements.
* Contribute expertise and recommendations to establishing Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai, and lead it as a center of excellence supporting customer innovation and business growth.
* Define laboratory objectives, budgets, equipment investment plans and capability-development roadmaps; manage resources, maintenance, calibration, utilization and materials inventory.
* Coordinate pilot-scale and customer-simulation trials, introduce new testing methodologies, and maintain protocols, formulation databases, technical reports and project documentation.
* Ensure compliance with Corbion’s safety, quality, food-safety and housekeeping standards and support internal and external laboratory audits.
* Deliver technical presentations, customer workshops, seminars and training programs, and support customer qualification processes and technical audits.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing to identify opportunities, develop the commercial pipeline and convert technical projects into business growth.
* Participate in strategic customer engagements, business reviews, innovation sessions, exhibitions, trade fairs and industry forums.
* Monitor market trends, regulatory developments, competitor activity and emerging technologies, and recommend innovation priorities based on customer and market insights.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and regional and global R&D teams.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring timely execution and, as the laboratory develops, help build and coach its technical capabilities.

**You bring**

*Requirements*

* A bachelor’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Biotechnology or a closely related food-science discipline.
* At least 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in food ingredients, food manufacturing or the specialty ingredients industry.
* Strong experience in customer-facing technical support and the credibility to work directly with experienced customer R&D and manufacturing teams.
* Strong knowledge of food ingredients and their functionality within finished-product applications, with strong technical expertise in bakery applications.
* Experience in at least one additional relevant category, preferably confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry or seafood. Deep bakery expertise with some confectionery exposure may also fit.
* The ability to explore customer needs in depth, ask strong technical questions and translate customer challenges into practical application and ingredient solutions.
* Experience with laboratory or application trials, formulation optimization, technical troubleshooting and implementation in customer production environments.
* Understanding of product scale-up and commercialization, including implementation across multiple customer manufacturing locations.
* Knowledge of food preservation, clean-label product development, food safety and microbiology fundamentals.
* Strong project leadership, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, communication, presentation and influencing skills.

title: Commercial Account Manager
description:
Commercial Account Manager – Sovos SOVOS
**Commercial Account Manager**
Sales

Build Your Future With Us
  
  
The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.
  
  
We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.
  
  
AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.
  
  
Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
  
  
The Role
  
  
At Sovos, we're looking for a Commercial Account Manager to help grow our most strategic client relationships across global markets. You'll sell SaaS-based tax compliance solutions to existing enterprise clients, manage complex sales cycles, and drive revenue growth in an emerging market while supporting accounts with ARR over $1 million.
  
  
**More Specifically, You Will**

* Develop and execute strategic account plans to identify and close expansion opportunities within your assigned global accounts.
* Sell and promote Sovos' SaaS-based products, with a focus on GST and tax compliance solutions, leveraging AI tools to improve targeting and personalisation.
* Manage a balanced pipeline in Salesforce.com, providing accurate sales data and consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets and quotas.

What You Bring to Sovos
  
  

* You've built solid corporate selling experience with a proven track record of quota attainment.
* You have strong knowledge of GST compliance, tax technology, or related industry.
* You've successfully sold large enterprise deals ($250K+) to senior executives and managed customer relationships in the North India market.
* You're comfortable working with Salesforce.com, MS Office suite, and exploring AI-assisted tools to streamline your work.
* Bachelor's degree in business or related field, or equivalent experience.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken).
* Self-motivated team player with a drive to exceed targets. Moderate travel required (less than 50%). Candidates must be residing in Delhi, Noida, or Gurgaon, as the position requires occasional region-specific collaboration.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

The Process

1
  
  
Pre-Employment Assessment
  
  
Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.
  
  
2

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.
  
  
3
  
  
Meeting with a Recruiter
  
  
A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.
  
  
4
  
  
Live Interviews with the Hiring Team
  
  
Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.
  
  
Life at Sovos
  
  
The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
  
  

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
* Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
* Remote Work Arrangement
* Annual Health Check-up

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
  
  
**Company Background**
Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.
  
  
More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.

As an Enterprise Growth Associate at IQWorks, you will take our data protection platform to the enterprises that need it most and stay with them from the first conversation through implementation and early success. You will lean on AI heavily to do the work that has traditionally been manual — research, account mapping, outreach, call prep, and follow-ups — while applying sharp judgment about where the human touch matters most, so relationships and deal quality are never compromised. We support hybrid working and flexible hours, and we look for people who bring the consistency and responsiveness that high-ownership work depends on. As we continue to expand our dynamic team, we remain committed to launching new products, pioneering innovations, and redefining wealth tracking for modern India.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




 We are looking for a highly driven and experienced
 **Customer Success Lead – Non\-Voice (Email Support** 
 ) to lead our customer support operations and deliver an exceptional customer experience. This role combines hands\-on customer support expertise with team leadership responsibilities. You will manage a team of 4–5 Customer Success Executives, oversee customer communication through email and ticketing platforms, and ensure timely resolution of customer queries related to portfolio tracking, investment data, integrations, and platform functionality. The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of financial markets, investment products, and SaaS platforms, as well as excellent written communication, analytical thinking, and leadership skills. We are looking for a self\-starter who can contribute from day one, work independently with minimal supervision, and take complete ownership of the customer support function.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Team Leadership \& Support Operations Management:** 



* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of 4–5 Customer Success Executives (Non\-Voice Email Support).
* Drive team productivity, service quality, SLA adherence, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Monitor ticket queues, workload distribution, escalations, and resolution timelines.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and feedback discussions to improve team effectiveness.
* Establish best practices for customer communication, issue resolution, and support processes.
* Take complete ownership of customer support coordination and day\-to\-day support operations.
* Ensure effective resource planning, workload management, and timely resolution of customer issues.



  





**2\. Customer Query Resolution \& Ticket Management:** 



* Manage customer support tickets end\-to\-end through email and helpdesk platforms.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve customer issues related to portfolio tracking, imports, reconciliations, integrations, reports, and product functionality.
* Ensure adherence to defined SLAs, response quality standards, and customer satisfaction goals.
* Prioritise and manage multiple customer conversations simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Handle critical customer escalations and drive timely resolutions.
* Maintain ownership of customer issues until they are successfully closed.



  





**3\. Quality Assurance, Audits \& Coaching:** 



* Conduct regular audits of customer support emails, tickets, and calls in accordance with the organisation's quality audit framework.
* Review customer interactions to ensure adherence to communication standards, product knowledge requirements, SLA commitments, and customer experience benchmarks.
* Track quality metrics and identify recurring gaps, trends, and opportunities for improvement across the team.
* Provide structured feedback, coaching, and training recommendations based on audit findings.
* Ensure consistent compliance with support processes, quality standards, and customer communication guidelines.
* Partner with relevant stakeholders to implement corrective and preventive actions based on audit observations.



  





**4\. Financial Data \& Investment Product Support:** 




 Assist customers with queries related to:
 


* Equities (Stocks)
* Mutual Funds
* PMS
* AIFs
* Bonds \& Fixed Income Instruments
* ETFs
* Alternative Investments



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Analysing portfolio data, transactions, holdings, and reports to identify root causes of customer issues.
* Assisting customers in understanding platform outputs, reports, performance calculations, and investment\-related data.
* Providing consultative guidance on data interpretation and portfolio reporting.



  





**5\. Customer Success \& Relationship Management:** 



* Deliver a high\-quality customer experience through professional, accurate, and empathetic written communication.
* Build trust and credibility by acting as a knowledgeable advisor to customers.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve customer adoption and platform utilisation.
* Gather and document customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring pain points.
* Ensure consistent communication and follow\-up throughout the customer lifecycle.



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 



* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, Onboarding, and Customer Success teams to resolve customer issues efficiently.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure smooth handling of escalations and customer concerns.
* Communicate customer insights, recurring trends, and improvement opportunities to internal teams.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.



  





**7\. Process Improvement \& Operational Excellence:** 



* Take ownership of continuously improving customer support processes, workflows, and operational efficiency.
* Identify process gaps, bottlenecks, recurring customer issues, and inefficiencies across the support function.
* Analyse support metrics, ticket trends, audit findings, customer feedback, and escalation patterns to drive improvements.
* Design and implement scalable solutions that improve response times, resolution quality, customer satisfaction, and team productivity.
* Develop, standardise, and maintain SOPs, workflows, quality guidelines, and best practices across the support team.
* Drive automation and process optimisation initiatives to reduce manual effort and improve operational effectiveness.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, and Customer Success teams to implement long\-term solutions for recurring issues.
* Track the impact of process improvement initiatives and establish measurable outcomes to ensure continuous enhancement of support operations.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence within the team.



  





**8\. Knowledge Management \& Documentation:** 



* Create and maintain internal knowledge resources, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and training documentation.
* Ensure knowledge repositories remain up to date with product enhancements, process changes, and resolutions of recurring issues.
* Contribute to onboarding and training initiatives for new team members.
* Promote knowledge sharing and best practices across the Customer Success team.



  





**Desired Candidate** 



* ProfileBachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Business, Economics, or a related field.
* 4\-6 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Support, Client Servicing, Operations, or related roles.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring customer support or customer success teams.
* Strong understanding of financial markets and investment products, including Stocks, Mutual Funds, PMS, AIFs, Bonds, ETFs, and other wealth management products.
* Excellent written communication skills with strong grammar and business email etiquette.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to investigate customer issues, identify root causes, and communicate solutions effectively.
* Experience working with SaaS products and technology platforms.
* Proficiency in helpdesk and ticketing tools such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Zoho Desk, or similar platforms.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work with financial data.



  





**Key Leadership Traits** 



* Self\-starter who can quickly understand processes and contribute from day one.
* Self\-learner with the ability to independently acquire product, process, and domain knowledge.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision while maintaining high accountability.
* Strong ownership mindset with the capability to independently manage and improve support operations.
* Comfortable making decisions, driving initiatives, and resolving challenges proactively.
* Strong focus on quality, process discipline, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to identify operational inefficiencies and implement sustainable solutions.
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to analyse support metrics, audit findings, and customer feedback to drive decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to build processes, improve team performance, and scale customer support operations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, and team coordination skills.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior experience in fintech, wealth\-tech, broking, investment advisory, mutual fund, PMS, AIF, or financial services organisations.
* Familiarity with portfolio management, capital markets, and investment operations.
* Exposure to customer support metrics, SLAs, CSAT, quality audits, and process improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing customer escalations and leading support teams in a fast\-paced SaaS environment.

 Manage One Large Account for Perfios with Strong business development, pipeline build \& management, Relationship building \& development, Escalation Management, Internal collaboration \& Stakeholder management skills.

 The Key Account Manager is responsible for developing a comprehensive sales strategy that aligns with the company's overall goals and objectives for a large account.  Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
   

  

 The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win\-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
   

  

 Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
   

  

 Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high\-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account\`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account\`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.
   

  

 Develop and strengthen the customer relationship, operating at the Key Account\`s technical department and technical management levels, to achieve preferred supplier status based on lasting personal relationships and the added value delivered.
   

  

 Solve and advise on operational requests, customer technical concerns and technical complaints related to survey and audit performance in close collaboration with relevant technical experts and the KAM to ensure continuous vessel trade. Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.
   

  

 Systematically identify any major technical and technical operation challenges and technical concerns related to the DNV interaction with the Key Account and cascade to the KAM and to relevant departments within DNV. Follow\-up with the findings and ensure that related improvement activities are executed under utilization of the relevant DNV organization.
   

  

 Bring in foresight and help spot and resolve potential technical problems before they occur.
   

  

 Consult the customer on technical matters in meetings, presentations and workshops together or in alignment with the KAM and relevant stakeholders within DNV .
   

  

 Train, guide and consult the Key Account on rules and regulations as well as on new tools and new work processes to help them leverage the full value of our solutions and to facilitate customer's planning and implementation into operations.
   

  

 Measure and monitor the Key Account\`s performance on critical technical key performance indicators, address and support improving performance gaps by developing adequate plans and actions in alignment with the KAM and the relevant DNV organization as well as the Key Account.
   

  

 While your focus is on technical issues, remain attentive towards identifying potential business opportunities and hand those over to the KAM.
   

  

 Pro\-actively stay up to date with relevant industry, regulatory and technology trends and best practices as well as with the relevant DNV products, services, processes and tools to remain relevant towards the Key Accounts.
   

  

 Liaise with Indian flag for Flag related matters.
   

  

 Experience working with MOU’s is an added advantage.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the maritime/offshore industry, with exposure to ship and MOU operations, classification requirements, and customer\-facing roles.
* Driven, goal\-oriented, and results\-focused professional with a proactive approach to achieving business objectives.
* Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and stakeholders.
* Capable of performing efficiently under pressure while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
* Forward\-thinking, innovative, and solution\-oriented, with strong analytical, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent customer engagement and relationship management abilities, with a proven capability to interact effectively at both operational and executive levels.
* Possesses strong knowledge of the maritime industry, offshore operations, and classification requirements.
* Experienced in ship and Mobile Offshore Unit (MOU) operations, enabling effective communication and engagement with a diverse customer base.

* Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* International exposure and experience working with multicultural teams and stakeholders are considered a strong advantage.

title: Account Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
   

  

 Account Manager – Marketing Clients
   

  

 Company: BingeAt Media LLP
   

 Department: Client Servicing / Marketing
   

 Location: Kalyan / Mumbai
   

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

 Experience: Minimum 3years in Account Management, Client Servicing, Digital Marketing or Agency Operations
   

  

 About the Role
   

  

 BingeAt Media LLP is looking for an Account Manager to manage day\-to\-day relationships with marketing clients and coordinate the successful execution of their marketing requirements.
   

  

 The Account Manager will be responsible for understanding client requirements, planning deliverables, coordinating with internal teams, maintaining communication, monitoring project progress, and ensuring client satisfaction and retention.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 1\. Client Management
   

  

 \- Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
   

 \- Understand client business objectives, requirements and expectations.
   

 \- Maintain regular communication through calls, meetings, email and approved communication channels.
   

 \- Build strong, professional and long\-term client relationships.
   

 \- Handle client feedback, concerns and escalations professionally.
   

  

 2\. Marketing Project Coordination
   

  

 \- Coordinate with Social Media, Performance Marketing, Creative, Content, Video and Web teams.
   

 \- Prepare and communicate briefs clearly to internal teams.
   

 \- Track project timelines, deliverables and approvals.
   

 \- Ensure deliverables are completed as per agreed scope and timelines.
   

 \- Follow up internally to avoid delays and bottlenecks.
   

  

 3\. Strategy \& Client Understanding
   

  

 \- Understand the client's business, target audience, competitors and marketing objectives.
   

 \- Participate in marketing planning and review meetings.
   

 \- Assist the team in developing monthly marketing plans, campaigns and content strategies.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve campaign and marketing performance.
   

  

 4\. Reporting \& Reviews
   

  

 \- Coordinate monthly/periodic performance reports.
   

 \- Present campaign updates and key performance metrics to clients.
   

 \- Maintain records of client feedback, approvals, pending items and action points.
   

 \- Conduct regular account reviews with clients where required.
   

  

 5\. Client Retention \& Growth
   

  

 \- Monitor client satisfaction and identify potential retention risks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for additional services based on client requirements.
   

 \- Coordinate cross\-selling/up\-selling of relevant services such as:
   

 \- Social Media Management
   

 \- Performance Marketing
   

 \- Branding \& Creative
   

 \- Website Development
   

 \- Video Production
   

 \- SEO
   

 \- Lead Generation
   

 \- Content Marketing
   

 \- Coordinate internally for proposals and quotations for additional requirements.
   

  

 6\. Account Administration
   

  

 \- Maintain updated client information, requirements, deliverables and communication records in the company's systems.
   

 \- Ensure proper documentation of approvals and important decisions.
   

 \- Follow BingeAt Media LLP's internal project management and documentation processes.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Excellent verbal and written communication.
   

 \- Strong client\-handling and relationship\-management skills.
   

 \- Good understanding of digital marketing and social media.
   

 \- Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
   

 \- Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines.
   

 \- Problem\-solving and escalation\-management ability.
   

 \- Good presentation and meeting skills.
   

 \- Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into actionable briefs.
   

 \- Working knowledge of Google Workspace and project\-management tools.
   

 \- Basic understanding of marketing metrics and campaign performance.
   

  

 Preferred Qualifications
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication or a related field.
   

 \- Prior experience in a digital marketing / advertising / creative agency.
   

 \- Experience handling multiple marketing accounts will be preferred.
   

  

 Performance Expectations
   

  

 The Account Manager will be expected to maintain:
   

  

 \- High client satisfaction and retention.
   

 \- Timely completion of client deliverables.
   

 \- Clear and proactive client communication.
   

 \- Accurate internal coordination and follow\-ups.
   

 \- Strong understanding of assigned client accounts.
   

 \- Identification of opportunities for account growth.
   

 \- Proper documentation and project tracking.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 \- Client Retention
   

 \- Client Satisfaction
   

 \- Timely Delivery of Projects
   

 \- Client Communication \& Response Management
   

 \- Account Growth / Cross\-Selling
   

 \- Quality of Briefs \& Internal Coordination
   

 \- Reduction in Client Escalations
   

 \- Timely Collection/Follow\-up coordination where assigned
   

  

 Reporting
   

  

 Reports To: General Manager / Business Head / Assigned Team Leader
   

  

 Works Closely With:
   

 Creative Team • Social Media Team • Performance Marketing Team • Content Team • Video Team • Web Development Team • Management
   

  

 Candidate Profile
   

  

 We are looking for someone who is proactive, organised, client\-focused and commercially aware, with the ability to manage relationships while ensuring that the internal team delivers work efficiently.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should not merely take instructions from clients—they should understand the client's business, anticipate requirements, coordinate solutions and contribute to the growth of the account.

**About Us**

 is a global healthtech company using artificial intelligence to improve disease detection and patient outcomes at scale. Our solutions are deployed across hospitals, diagnostic networks, and public health programs worldwide.
 



 Today, our technology has impacted
 **40M\+ lives** 
 across
 **105\+ countries**

 **5,200\+ sites**

 **26 FDA\-cleared indications**

**The Opportunity** 




 Qure.ai’s AI solutions are already embedded in the workflows of leading pharmaceutical companies such as AstraZeneca, Merck, Lilly and J\&J. As pharma continues to be our fastest\-growing business in the US, this is a field\-facing, high\-ownership role at the forefront of driving our next phase of growth.
 



  





 You’ll report to the Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships, who leads partnership strategy and deal development, and work closely with our Strategy and Growth Team, who support account planning, commercial collateral, and deal execution. You'll also collaborate with the SVP, Life Sciences Partnerships, who leads the business globally. In this role, you'll own the field\-building pipeline, developing strategic customer relationships, and driving opportunities from initial engagement through to successful closure.
 



 This role is designed as a high\-growth commercial path, with opportunities to take ownership of strategic accounts and grow into senior partnerships as the business scales.
 



  





 If you’re 3–5 years into a career in healthcare consulting, life sciences, digital health, or a client\-facing commercial role, and are eager to build strategic relationships, create new business opportunities, and thrive in a fast\-paced, field\-facing environment, this role is built for you.
 



  





  





**What You’ll Own \& Drive** 



* Build and manage a pipeline of pharma partnership opportunities across oncology, cardiology, respiratory and other priority therapeutic areas.
* Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders – including Medical Affairs, Market Access, Digital Health and Commercial leads \- within strategic accounts including AstraZeneca, Merck, Lilly and J\&J, while expanding into new pharma logos.
* Represent Qure.ai at industry conferences, customer meetings and life sciences events across the US \- identifying new opportunities and converting engagements into qualified pipeline.
* Partner with the Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships to shape partnership strategies and commercial opportunities by translating Qure.ai's clinical and AI capabilities into compelling value propositions.
* Collaborate closely with the Strategy and Growth team to develop account plans, proposals, presentations, and commercial collateral that support successful customer engagements.
* Own the day\-to\-day commercial execution, including prospecting, outreach, meeting cadence, CRM management, follow\-ups, forecasting, and pipeline reporting.
* Develop a strong understanding of priority disease areas, clinical workflows, and Qure.ai's AI solutions to engage credibly with physicians, scientists, and pharmaceutical stakeholders.
* Drive opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution, partnering with the Senior Director on commercial structuring, negotiations, and final approvals.








  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Within your first 6–12 months, you will have:
 


* Built and actively managed a qualified pipeline of strategic pharmaceutical partnership opportunities, with accurate forecasting and CRM reporting.
* Represented Qure.ai at major industry conferences and customer events, establishing meaningful relationships with key stakeholders across strategic pharmaceutical accounts.
* Successfully progressed at least one partnership opportunity from initial engagement through to contract execution, in collaboration with the Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships.
* Developed sufficient expertise across multiple disease areas and clinical workflows to independently lead introductory customer discussions and identify partnership opportunities.
* Established yourself as a trusted commercial partner through well\-developed account plans, disciplined pipeline management, and reliable execution



  





  





**Core Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 3–5 years of experience in strategy or management consulting, healthcare, life sciences, digital health, or pharmaceutical commercial roles, or another high\-performance, client\-facing environment.
* Bachelor's degree required; an MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Demonstrated success in building and managing client relationships, driving commercial opportunities, and delivering against commitments with a high degree of ownership.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders across pharmaceutical organizations.
* Strong analytical and learning agility, with the ability to quickly understand new disease areas, clinical workflows, and AI\-driven healthcare solutions.
* Willingness to travel extensively across the United States for customer meetings, conferences, and industry events (approximately 40% travel, if applicable).



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior experience working with pharmaceutical companies, healthcare providers, or life sciences organizations.
* Exposure to Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, or Digital Health functions within the pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience selling or partnering around healthcare technology, SaaS, AI, diagnostics, or digital health solutions.

**Company Description** 
 Octa Build is a Mumbai\-based building materials procurement company that consolidates steel, cement, electricals, plumbing, wall finishes, tiles, and more into a single sourcing window for clients across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The company is known for rapid quote turnaround, high on\-time\-in\-full delivery performance, and a simplified process involving one purchase order, one payment, and one point of contact. Each recurring account is supported by a dedicated Key Account Manager to ensure consistent service, strong relationships, and reliable project support.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Key Account Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for managing and growing strategic customer relationships across builders, contractors, architects, and industrial clients. Day\-to\-day activities include understanding customer requirements, preparing and following up on quotations, monitoring order status, analyzing account performance, and identifying opportunities for cross\-selling and upselling. The Key Account Manager will also develop account plans, maintain detailed records of interactions, and provide regular updates and reports to management on account health and revenue growth.

* Strong Account Management and Key Accounts experience, with the ability to build long\-term, trust\-based relationships.

* Business Planning capabilities to create account plans, forecast demand, and contribute to sales strategy.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in local languages is an advantage.
* Experience in building materials, construction, or related B2B industries preferred.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, operationally focused environment with attention to detail and follow\-through.

  Wallet\-share expansion in top 15 accounts — measured as % revenue from under\-penetrated categories (cement, tiles, plumbing, wall finishes)

 Track record of expanding a shrinking spend into a growing spend within the same account

title: Business Manager -Growth & Strategy
description:
**Job Discription:** 




  




* **Business Ownership \& Targets:** 
 Own assigned business targets and initiatives end\-to\-end, from problem identification to execution and measurement.

 Identify performance gaps, customer drop\-offs, and growth opportunities; develop structured solutions and clear action plans.

 • Experience in Fintech, NBFC, Digital Lending, Financial Services, or a high\-growth consumer business will be preferred.

title: Operation Manager - FMS
description:
Reporting to: Senior Operation Manager – FMS
   

  

 CTC: 50,000 per month
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Lead and optimize day\-to\-day operations of the Facility Management Services (FMS) division in the assigned region while actively driving new business growth. Ensure high\-quality service delivery, strong client relationships, operational efficiency, and achievement of revenue and profitability targets through effective leadership, process excellence, and strategic business development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities**
* Operational Management
* Oversee complete FMS operations including maintenance, housekeeping, security, landscaping, and allied facility services.
* Develop, implement, and enforce standardized policies, SOPs, procedures, and quality \& safety standards.
* Track and analyse operational KPIs; identify inefficiencies and lead continuous improvement projects.
* Ensure full compliance with statutory, health, safety, and environmental regulations through regular audits.
* Client Relationship Management
* Serve as the main point of contact for key accounts; deeply understand client requirements and expectations.
* Partner with sales \& service teams to create customized solutions and successfully renew/expand contracts.
* Resolve complaints, escalations, and service issues promptly while maintaining high client satisfaction.
* Conduct periodic client review meetings to gather feedback and uncover additional business opportunities.
* Business Development
* Prospect and acquire new clients in the Gujarat
* Formulate and execute effective sales \& business development strategies.
* Perform market analysis to identify growth opportunities and monitor competitor activity.
* Prepare compelling proposals, negotiate commercial terms, and close new contracts.
* Build and leverage professional networks through industry events, referrals, and targeted outreach.
* Financial \& P\&L Ownership
* Prepare and manage the annual operating budget for the region/division.
* Take full ownership of regional Profit \& Loss (P\&L) – revenue, costs, margins, and variances.
* Drive cost optimization, improve resource productivity, and protect service quality.
* Review and enhance pricing models, contract structures, and vendor commercial terms.
* Deliver accurate financial reporting, forecasting, and insights to senior leadership.


**Section IV: Knowledge, Experience \& Skills**
**Educational Qualifications**
 Graduate in any discipline (Hotel Management / relevant field preferred) Master’s degree an advantage
   

  

**Experience**
 Minimum 4\+ years in operations management (facility management, hospitality, or related sectors preferred)
   

  

 Key Competencies
   

  

* Strong leadership and team management
* Excellent decision\-making and analytical skills
* Superior verbal \& written communication
* Client\-centric approach with strong negotiation ability
* Data\-driven problem solving
* Proficiency in MS Office, ERP, and operational reporting tools
* Sound commercial \& business acumen


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* New business revenue \& client acquisition targets achieved
* Client retention rate \& satisfaction scores (NPS/CSAT)
* Regional P\&L – budgeted revenue, EBITDA/margin delivery
* Operational cost efficiency \& productivity improvement
* Timely resolution of client issues (SLA adherence)
* Zero critical safety / compliance violations
* Successful execution of process improvements \& cost\-saving projects
* Preventive vs. reactive maintenance ratio improvement


**Typical Daily / Weekly Activities**
* Review daily/weekly operational dashboards and site performance reports
* Lead team briefings and set daily/weekly priorities
* Conduct client site visits for inspections, relationship strengthening, and issue resolution
* Progress business development pipeline (leads, proposals, negotiations)
* Monitor budget vs. actuals and initiate corrective actions
* Coordinate with vendors and internal stakeholders for service delivery
* Handle client escalations and follow up on action plans
* Prepare MIS reports and senior management updates


**Self\-Image Required**
 Project a polished, confident, and client\-focused professional image consistent with premium facility management standards:
   

  

* Appearance — Well\-groomed, business/formal attire appropriate for client meetings and site visits
* Demeanor — Approachable, calm, solution\-oriented, and responsive under pressure
* Presence — Credible, decisive leader who inspires trust in teams, clients, and partners


**Essential Personal Traits**
* High integrity and ethical conduct
* Strong results orientation and target achievement drive
* Proactive mindset with anticipation of issues
* High energy level and resilience under pressure
* Sharp commercial awareness and negotiation skill
* Collaborative team player
* Positive, solution\-focused attitude
* Adaptable to changing client \& operational priorities
* Creative thinking for process and business improvement

title: Solutions Architect - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI\-native software development actually looks like in production.
   

  

 This is a deeply technical, post\-sale role embedded inside SpaceXAI’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high\-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
   

  

 Solution Architects sit at the center of long\-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
   

  

 This role is highly hands\-on. You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long\-term architecture for AI\-native development.
   

  

 The best Solution Architects combine deep technical credibility with strong product instincts, high ownership, and the ability to influence how large engineering organizations evolve. Solution Architects are also equally comfortable debugging CI workflows, leading architecture reviews, and helping executives understand where AI changes the economics of software development.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI\-Native Development**
* Roll out Cursor across strategic engineering organizations
* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands\-on enablement sessions
* Help developers integrate Cursor into real production workflows, not isolated demos
* Drive fast time\-to\-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly


**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**
* Identify where Cursor should expand next inside the customer environment
* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company\-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI\-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments


**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**
* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI\-native development evolves


**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**
* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization


**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**
* Deepen workflow adoption and long\-term product stickiness
* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without


**Shape the Future of the Product**
* Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering
* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns


**You may be a fit if**
* You have a strong technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling
* You have experience in customer\-facing technical roles such as Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar
* You have the ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership
* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast\-moving environments with ambiguity
* You have a passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
* You are willing to travel to customers needed

description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology company building AI\-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.
   

  

 Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

****ABOUT THE ROLE:****
 We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own our enterprise customer relationships end to end. Our CS team owns the full commercial relationship, strategic account management, adoption, renewal, expansion, and customer support, working directly with enterprise customers and their C\-suite. This is a senior individual\-contributor (IC) role for someone who can build trust and credibility at that level.
   

  

 At the heart of the role is discovery. The best expansion comes from deeply understanding what each customer is really trying to achieve, where their pain sits, and how Portcast turns their data into decisions and measurable business impact. Strong discovery is what lets you deepen adoption, grow your accounts, and drive real revenue from your existing customers, through upsell, cross\-sell, and new teams and regions.
   

  

 You'll also be technically fluent enough to be the customer's first point of contact on their questions and tickets, triaging the issue, working with our Data team to get the answer, and communicating a clear resolution back to the customer, all alongside the strategic work: QBRs, success plans, renewals, and expansion.
   

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**
* Enterprise customers deeply adopt Portcast with measurable business outcomes, and see you as a trusted advisor at both the operational and C\-suite level.
* Discovery that consistently surfaces real customer needs and turns them into adoption, retention, and expansion.
* A steady expansion pipeline from existing accounts (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams and regions), with CS trusted, internally and by customers, to identify and drive those deals.
* Fast, credible resolution of customer questions and tickets, in partnership with the Data team, so customers always get reliable answers and stay confident in Portcast.


**WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**
* Own the full enterprise customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewal, and retention, ensuring a smooth, high\-impact experience.
* Lead discovery: deeply understand each customer's goals, workflows, pain points, and internal decision processes, so you can grow the account and drive expansion.
* Be a trusted advisor to enterprise stakeholders, including C\-suite, aligning Portcast to their strategic goals and addressing their challenges.
* Identify and drive expansion (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams, new regions) in partnership with Sales, positioning CS as a credible driver of new revenue from existing customers.
* Own customer questions and tickets: triage the issue, work with the Data team to get the answer, then review and communicate a clear resolution back to the customer.
* Run QBRs, success plans, and regular check\-ins, using data, outcomes, and clear narratives to drive adoption and expansion.
* Partner with Product, Data, and Engineering to channel customer feedback and influence the roadmap.
* Analyze customer usage and data to surface actionable insights and continuously improve the customer journey.


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Logistics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent.
* 7\+ years in a commercial, customer\-facing role, Customer Success, Account Management, Pre\-sales/Solutions, or Sales, within the logistics industry or logistics technology space.
* A pre\-sales or solutions background is highly valued. Strong discovery is one of the most important skills in this role, it's what lets you expand existing customers and drive new revenue.
* Logistics / logistics\-tech domain: familiarity with freight forwarding and global logistics workflows, and the ability to confidently engage customers across operations and commercial stakeholders.
* Comfortable with enterprise customers and their C\-suite, with strong stakeholder management across functions and seniority levels.
* Technical fluency: comfortable with basic data, APIs, and SaaS concepts, enough to handle customer questions and tickets, work with our Data team, and translate technical answers into clear customer\-facing resolutions.
* A track record of driving account expansion (upsell, cross\-sell) and revenue growth from existing customers.
* Experience running QBRs and structured account success plans, using data and outcomes to drive adoption and expansion.
* Excellent, structured communication, especially with complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise customers.
* High ownership and independence, with the ability to operate in a lean startup environment and a bias for action.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**
* Work at the intersection of AI, data, and logistics: help enterprise customers turn predictive data into decisions and measurable business impact.
* Real impact from day one: we're lean by design, with few layers between you and the outcome, so your work moves adoption, retention, and expansion directly.
* Globally distributed, remote\-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO:**
* Curiosity: This is where discovery lives. We dig beneath what a customer asks for to what they're actually trying to achieve, staying genuinely curious about their business, their workflows, and how a freight forwarder really operates. That depth is where every expansion starts.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We own the customer relationship and the commercial outcome end to end, adoption, renewal, and expansion, and we stay on an account until the value is real and the number moves.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for a renewed contract. We aim for customers who adopt deeply, expand with us, and become advocates, and we hold ourselves to that standard on every account.
* Effectiveness: We focus on the outcomes that matter, real adoption, retention, and revenue growth from our customers, not check\-ins or activity for their own sake. We prioritize the accounts and conversations that actually move the business.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

 **client relationship management, team leadership, expert identification, project delivery, and account growth**

**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
